caption: The drawing depicts an ornate iron fence with pointed tips and decorative loops, rendered mostly in grayscale pencil. The central section features a decorative gate with intricate scrollwork at the top, above which is inscribed "1853." Within the gate's lower section is a colored scene, drawn in green, blue, and brown hues, showing a weeping willow tree with drooping branches, centrally placed, and flanked by two reclining sheep, one on each side of the tree. The colored portion contrasts with the otherwise monochrome depiction of the fence, which includes repeated vertical and pointed elements. The background is plain and unadorned.
title: Cast Iron Gate and Fence
